about: THE HERO REVEAL v2 (docs/design/HERO_REVEAL_V2.md; the owner 13.11 ~21:00): the cut-in title card that plays when a hero joins. Drawn by src/render/paint/heroReveal.ts. A new hero is one entry under heroes: his words (every visible word is here, drawn through the text.ts roles), the announcer's voice group (silent when not recorded), his layers and pivots (face: the reveal-only expression patch, a lifted level brow and a slight smirk, ?revface=0 for the face as made; eli: cut by art/hero_reveal/cut_eli.py from the paid reveal figure raw/97_97_reveal_eli_figure, made by art/specs/reveal_eli_figure.json from the owner-approved sheet3 pose 1) and his colours. A titleRun ({text, cutAt 0..1, everyF}) replaces the name punch with the title-run gag (the plate grows, runs off the screen, the announcer runs out of breath at cutAt). standIns.titleRun is the debug stand-in (?herorev=eli&revtitle=1), never shown without the flag.

titleRun.about: the coming rabbi's title, exactly as the owner gave it (13.11, corrected: no personal name after it); tested on Eli's slot only behind ?revtitle=1
